notes: Asking for a second edit with the word "after" now works whichever way you write it. "Make it vertical after muting it" always did both jobs, but "make it vertical after mute it" quietly did only the reframe and threw the mute away without saying so — and the card gave no hint that half the request had gone missing. Crisp reads the plain form now, including "after that mute it". Naming a moment rather than an edit still means what it always did: "trim it after the intro" and "keep everything after 10 seconds" are untouched.
